notes.acpm: ACPM (APM firmware) client constants for shim/acpm.c: read from source, docs/research/23-acpm-regulator-client.md (GK gs101.dtsi:491-507, acpm_ipc.c, acpm_mfd.c, framework.h). mbox/sram/initdata/ch_id/speedy_ch/pmic_addr/intgr1/intcr0/intsr0 are [src] and pinned by tools/boards.py (_ACPM_PINS); desc_stride 0x48 and the u32 field offsets inside shim/acpm.c are hand-derived (guess) until layout_verified is set to 1 after comparing the shim's descriptor dump (--touch-probe=railsr) with a real read; elem_unit = bytes per q_elem_size unit: 1 = q_elem_size is in BYTES, read from source (acpm_ipc.c:762 passes tx_ch.size to memcpy_align_4 as a byte count; the MFD callers pass unsigned int command[4]; Google acpm.c:257-271), the shim requires q_elem_size * elem_unit == 16 and elem_unit_verified stays 0 until the --touch-probe=railsr buffer dump shows 16-byte slots (docs/research/23 erratum). rails: S2MPG10 enable registers 0x5C/0x5D bit 7 (doc 23 section 1); vsel_min/vsel_max = accepted voltage code range (reg bits 5:0) before the rail is enabled, derived by tools/boards.py check from the regulator group (gk_s2mpg10-register.h:319-323: group 4 = 700 mV + 25 mV * code, group 5 = 1800 mV + 25 mV * code; s2mpg10-regulator.c:275-278, vsel_mask = 63) and the device-tree limits (gs101-pmic.dtsi:535-553: L25M 1.60-1.95 V = codes 0x24-0x32, L26M 2.5-3.3 V = codes 0x1C-0x3C); null = unknown, and then the shim refuses to write. Flags flipped 2026-10-22 after run acpm3 (observed on bluejay: descriptor fields at the derived offsets, q_len=5, q_elem_size=0x10 with 5x16 B slots, both queues empty 3/3); the rails themselves are still unread. dvfs: ACPM DVFS channel 1 (gs101.dtsi:720 exynos_dm acpm-ipc-channel), domain indexes CPUCL0/1/2 = 2/3/4 (dt-bindings/clock/gs101.h:305-307, GET_IDX = id & 0xFFFF); rates_khz = the firmware fvmap rows OBSERVED on the phone (run fvmap1, 2026-10-22, docs/research/25); ceiling_khz is ours (no thermal management exists), a request must be a row at or below it.
notes.watchdogs: two cluster watchdogs armed by ABL; the shim disables them
notes.touch: SPI11 / USI11_USI_PERIC1 engine, its USI mode register and the three pad banks the Pixel 6a touchscreen uses (feeds the /sweet-touch ADT node, tools/mkadt.py, xnu patch 0088). read from source: engine 0x10D40000 and sysreg_peric1 0x10C21000 + usi-offset 0x0c = 0x10C2100C: Google gs101-usi.dtsi:603-621,66 (docs/research/05-fact-check.md section 1); USI mode SPI = BIT(1), mask = UART|SPI|I2C = 0x7: Linux drivers/soc/samsung/exynos-usi.c:19-25; USI_CON/USI_OPTION live at engine + 0xc0 (exynos-usi.c:28-34; the +0xc0 position is from the mainline usi1.. nodes, gs101.dtsi:378, and applied to USI11 by analogy = guess); pad banks: PERIC1 pinctrl 0x10C40000 (Linux gs101.dtsi:916-918) + gpp23 0x60, gpp26 0xc0 (pinctrl-exynos-arm64.c gs101_pin_peric1), ALIVE pinctrl 0x174D0000 (gs101.dtsi:1414-1416) + gpa9 0xc0 (gs101_pin_alive). Flags flipped 2026-10-22 after run acpm3 (observed on bluejay: descriptor fields at the derived offsets, q_len=5, q_elem_size=0x10 with 5x16 B slots, both queues empty 3/3); the rails themselves are still unread.
